body.x: EKLEER, a leader in affordable technology solutions for emerging markets, has been recognized as a CES 2025 Innovation Awards Honoree in the Computer Peripherals & Accessories category for its groundbreaking Smart Display for Digital Inclusion. The award highlights EKLEER’s dedication to bridging the digital divide through innovative, cost-effective technology that empowers underserved communities.

Headquartered in Suwon, Korea, EKLEER specializes in developing smart display solutions that turn smartphones into powerful tools for education, work, and healthcare. The company remains committed to driving social impact in emerging markets through accessible technology, transforming lives, and closing the digital divide.

The Smart Display for Digital Inclusion features a 21.5-inch Full HD screen optimized for educational, professional, and healthcare applications. Designed with weights on accessibility, the Display connects seamlessly to Android smartphones via a single USB-C port, enabling continuous charging and uninterrupted productivity. Additional features include a USB-A hub for essential peripherals and dual 8W speakers for an immersive multimedia experience. Its intuitive design gives users a vibrant, large-format workstation powered by smartphones.

“This recognition reinforces our vision to make technology more accessible and impactful for those in emerging markets,” said Matthew Chung, CEO & Founder of EKLEER. “By transforming any Android smartphone into a functional workstation, our smart display enables broader access to digital productivity, education, and more.”

The CES Innovation Awards program celebrates consumer technology products that demonstrate innovation, engineering, and user experience excellence. EKLEER’s Smart Display was honored for its ability to meet the unique needs of underserved communities and provide a cost-effective solution for digital inclusion.
CES 2025 will occur in Las Vegas, Nevada, from January 7 to 10, where EKLEER will showcase its award-winning Smart Display at the Innovation Awards Showcase.

Pangyo Techno Valley is a global integrated R&D hub focused on IT, BT, CT, and NT, integrating Research (R), People (P), Information (I), and Trade (T). As Gyeonggi-do’s representative innovation cluster, Pangyo Techno Valley was established to secure national new growth drivers such as technological innovation, human resource development, job creation, and enhancing international business competitiveness. As of 2023, 1,666 companies employ 78,751 people, and it has positioned itself as the most innovative hub in South Korea, with sales amounting to 167.7 trillion KRW (125.5 billion USD).

Furthermore, the Techno Valley Innovation Division of the Gyeonggi-do Business & Science Accelerator (GBSA) holds monthly events such as the Pangyo Evening Meet-Up, Pan-Pan Day, and the Pangyo Startup Investment Exchange “In-Best Pangyo” to maximize the value of Pangyo Techno Valley. They also support the Pangyo Overseas Promotion Program, which publicizes information about Pangyo’s companies, products, and services to domestic and foreign investors and the media, thereby facilitating foreign investment.
